Europe PMC metadata, including MEDLINE records. PubMed E-utilities are not called: eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov robots.txt is Disallow: /. Queries cover phase 3 titles, a fixed high-impact journal list, and AI-in-biology titles. Titles that assert efficacy or effectiveness are skipped, except Nature news DOIs (10.1038/d41586-) whose titles name a trial, phase, FDA action, pivotal study, readout, or approval. Those items get the pivotal-readout adjustment, and their blurb is the page meta description when nature.com/robots.txt allows the article. A blurb otherwise uses one results sentence of at most 25 words when abstractText is present, and the journal otherwise. The abstract is not copied. Crawl-delay on ebi.ac.uk is respected.
Read-only use of calendar/calendar.json. The ClinicalTrials.gov API is not called, because robots.txt disallows /api/. Study-page links are used. This job does not write calendar files.

biorxiv details API, 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-22, 90 metadata rows scanned. Titles are linked to the preprint page. A blurb uses one results sentence of at most 25 words when the abstract is present, and otherwise says the server and that the item is a preprint, not peer-reviewed. The abstract is not copied. Category filter is bioinformatics, genomics, synthetic biology, systems biology, pharmacology, or bioengineering for bioRxiv, and clinical categories with a therapy or trial word for medRxiv, plus AI-method titles.

medrxiv details API, 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-22, 120 metadata rows scanned. Titles are linked to the preprint page. Category filter is bioinformatics, genomics, synthetic biology, systems biology, pharmacology, or bioengineering for bioRxiv, and clinical categories with a therapy or trial word for medRxiv, plus AI-method titles.

BioCatalystFeed Worker /papers, which proxies the Europe PMC search API. Same metadata terms as a direct Europe PMC call. Titles that assert efficacy are skipped. Duplicate DOIs collapse with the direct Europe PMC source.

BioCatalystFeed Worker /ai-discovery. Curated model cards are included only when verified_as_of or published falls in the last 45 days. arXiv rows come from the worker's allowlisted category query and are labeled as preprints. Summaries are not copied. No X client is called.

NIH RePORTER project search for titles matching gene therapy, cell therapy, monoclonal antibody, CRISPR, drug discovery with a project start from 2026-09-08 to 2026-11-22. Award amounts and activity codes are the API fields. Abstracts are not copied. The API is the public RePORTER service; project pages are linked.

SEC EDGAR daily index Form 8-K rows for 125 tickers already listed in calendar/calendar.json. 7 index days were not posted (403 or 404), which is how SEC answers for a weekend, a holiday, or a file that is not up yet. Requests use BioCatalystFeed contact@biocat.ai, per the SEC fair-access User-Agent rule, and stay on /files and /Archives (not /cgi-bin, which robots.txt disallows). Item codes come from the data.sec.gov submissions index for the companies that already matched. Routine items such as earnings, officer changes, and exhibits-only filings are ranked lower. The filing text itself is not copied.
